peak_all_busy_1p2.note: every holding pair busy at once (field-wide op, no cap)

peak_cap50_1p2.note: 50% checkerboard cap: a pair still draws its full current on its beats (element level unchanged); cluster and die carry half

saturation_duty_1p2.note: model saturation duty (busy pair-equivalents 543 / 7,102) as an average; the peak of an op inside it is the peak case

budget.basis: ASAP7 SS libraries are characterised at 0.63 V (-10%); static IR, first droop and regulator tolerance all spend it

levers: element: the W10 pair's grid is M5/M6 only (5.4 um per net) and its worst node is 22.5 mV at 0.239 W -- the largest term; re-harden with M7 power straps (also needed for abutment and a reachable abstract)

die: ASAP7 M8/M9 are thin (0.34 ohm/sq); a production 5 nm-class stack has thick top metals and an RDL, roughly an order of magnitude lower, so the die term here is pessimistic (ASSUMED ratio, PDK-limited)
bump pitch 40 um with 1/3 VDD (ASSUMED); a denser power-bump share lowers the die term directly
the 50% cap halves the cluster and die terms; saturation duty is an average, not a peak
